## 第一周

1. 服务包指定健康管理师失败的问题排查
2. 随诊资金池 测试&上线
3. 服务包兼职医生逻辑重定义
4. 服务包&就诊人文档梳理

```go
select status from med_d2d.orderTransaction where id IN(102731,104728,104797,104802,105147,105296,105532,105645,105751,105795,105796,105854,105933,106079,106248,106273,106321,106978,107175,107218,107275,107305,107306,107382,107486,107559,107575,108146,108412,108500,108502,108595,108676,108709,108736,108746,108794,109037,109038,109039,109107,109237,109359,109457,109459,109460,109461,109524,109586,109604,109806,110115,110159,110325,110426,110481,110744,111063,111466,111695,111981,112031,112154,112822,113119,113120,113121,113391,113434,113500,113547,113727)
```

```go

SELECT count(id) FROM med_d2d.chatOrder WHERE status IN(3,4) AND settlementStatus IN(7) AND price > 0 AND orderId > 0 AND is_new_order = 1 AND settlementId = 0;

SET SESSION group_concat_max_len=102400;
SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME( chatOrder.insertTime, '%Y%m' ) AS months, SUM(price), COUNT(id), GROUP_CONCAT(id) FROM med_d2d.chatOrder WHERE status IN(3,4) AND settlementStatus IN(7) AND price > 0 AND orderId > 0 AND is_new_order = 1 AND settlementId = 0 GROUP BY months;

SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME( chatOrder.insertTime, '%Y%m' ) AS months, SUM(price) FROM med_d2d.chatOrder WHERE status IN(3,4) AND settlementStatus IN(7) AND price > 0 AND orderId > 0 AND is_new_order = 1 AND settlementId = 0 GROUP BY months;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(price)/100, 2) FROM med_d2d.chatOrder WHERE status IN(3,4) AND settlementStatus IN(7) AND price > 0 AND orderId > 0 AND is_new_order = 1 AND settlementId = 0 AND insertTime < 1612108800;

select FROM_UNIXTIME( end_term_time, '%Y%m' ) from med_service.service_order where status IN(1) and doctor_id > 0;

select new_pay_order_id from med_d2d.chatOrder AS co LEFT JOIN med_d2d.orderTransaction AS ot ON ot.orderId = co.orderId WHERE co.id IN(98660,98692,98729,98866,99294,99295,99296,99709,100179,100229,100787,100788,100790,100795,102465,103125,103281,103432,103493,103794,103807,103882,104552,105110,105533,105627,105632,106272,107473,107981,108268,108377,108731,109498);
```
